[EN] [Solo] The Melancholy of a Designer
[ES] [Solo] La melancolía de un diseñador
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Meren in Highwatch.
[ES] Ve con Meren a Highwatch.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll help."
[ES] "Te ayudaré".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Clahk near the Training Ground in Highwatch.
[ES] Ve con Clahk cerca del campo de entrenamiento en Highwatch.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Training Ground
[ES] Campo de entrenamiento
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Destroy the Priest Buff Stone or Mystic Buff Stone two times.
The Training Ground is a dungeon for simulating your skills. You do not have to clear this dungeon.
[ES] Destruye la piedra de mejora de Sacerdote o la piedra de mejora de Místico dos veces.
El campo de entrenamiento es una mazmorra para simular tus habilidades. No tienes que completarla.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Training Ground
[ES] Campo de entrenamiento
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Leave the dungeon after you simulate your skills at the training monsters.
[ES] Sal de la mazmorra después de simular tus habilidades con los monstruos de entrenamiento.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Atpeman.
[ES] Habla con Atpeman.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Obtain the Captivity Stone.
[ES] Consigue la Piedra del cautiverio.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Clahk.
[ES] Habla con Clahk.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the Captivity Stone to empower the Eternal Crown. [Press key to open your inventory and select the Captivity Stone.]
[ES] Usa la Piedra del cautiverio para potenciar la Corona Eterna. [Presiona la tecla para abrir tu inventario y selecciona la Piedra del cautiverio.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak to Meren in Highwatch.
[ES] Habla con Meren en Highwatch.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
